<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>current</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST API:  ConfigurationNOW   (API ID: configurationnow)
 * Base path:          /api/x_2160899_driftw_0/configurationnow
 * Resource:           GET /current
 * Requires authentication: true
 * ACLs / roles:       restrict to x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_read (see README)
 *
 * Returns a live snapshot of the current instance's settings. Nothing is
 * written. Optional query params:
 *   categories=plugins,applications   limit the categories collected
 *
 * IMPORTANT: the collector uses GlideRecord, which does not enforce ACLs, so
 * this resource MUST be role-restricted. Secure-property hashes are removed
 * unless the caller has x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_read_secure.
 *
 * This endpoint is also the future contract for cross-instance collection:
 * a central instance calls GET /current on each Dev/Test/Sub-Prod/Prod node.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
    // Defence in depth: enforce the role here as well as via REST ACLs, because
    // the collector reads system tables with GlideRecord (no ACL checks).
    if (!gs.hasRole('x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_read')) {
        response.setStatus(403);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Requires role x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_read' });
        return;
    }
    var opts = {};
    var cats = request.queryParams.categories;
    if (cats && cats.length) opts.categories = String(cats[0]).split(',');

    var snapshot = new ConfigNowCollector(opts).collect();

    if (!gs.hasRole('x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_read_secure')) {
        var props = snapshot.categories.system_properties;
        if (props) {
            for (var i = 0; i < props.items.length; i++) {
                if (props.items[i].secure) props.items[i].secure_value_hash = '(restricted)';
            }
        }
    }
    response.setStatus(200);
    response.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    response.setBody(snapshot);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_2160899_driftw_0/configurationnow/current</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/current</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-04 14:22:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>6e34cc628314d710f22797efeeaad354</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>current</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Driftwood" source="x_2160899_driftw_0">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Driftwood">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_6e34cc628314d710f22797efeeaad354</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-04 14:22:25</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ConfigurationNOW">9234cc628314d710f22797efeeaad34b</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
